description: This file contains implementation of functions related to engine trigger decoders, including calculating engine cycle angles, configuring trigger shapes for various engine setups, and handling trigger event generation based on tooth wheel information.

methods.name: angle_t getEngineCycle(operation_mode_e operationMode)

methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape for a wheel with skipped teeth, including validation and setting synchronization parameters.

methods.name: void configureOnePlusOne(TriggerShape * s,operation_mode_e operationMode)
methods.description: Configures trigger events for a specific engine setup with primary and secondary triggers without skipped teeth.

methods.name: void configureOnePlus60_2(TriggerShape * s,operation_mode_e operationMode)
methods.description: Configures trigger events for a setup with 60 teeth and 2 skipped teeth, including secondary trigger adjustments.

methods.name: void configure3_1_cam(TriggerShape * s,operation_mode_e operationMode)
methods.description: Configures trigger events for a 3/1 cam setup with multiple trigger points representing engine cycles.
